subject: bivariate dual change score with multiple groups

messages.author: b4789affb98456b2
messages.subject: bivariate dual change score with multiple groups
parts:
Hi everyone, 

Just introduced to SEM and joining the community, I would like to fit a BDCS to my data which involve 3 different groups (which my have different starting means and different changes over time). I don't know where I should specify the different estimates for the 3 different groups. Could someone help me ? Thanks a lot in advance!

Here is the model for now : 

H1<-'

t0_lv=~1*t0         # Defining the latent variables
t1_lv=~1*t1         # Defining the latent variables
t2_lv=~1*t2         # Defining the latent variables
t0 ~ age_years+ses_index # Defining SES and AGE as regressors in t0

t1_lv ~ 1*t0_lv     # This parameter regresses ses_t1 perfectly on ses_t0
t2_lv ~ 1*t1_lv     # This parameter regresses ses_t2 perfectly on ses_t1

dlv1 =~ 1*t1_lv         # This defines the dlv score as measured perfectly by scores on t1
dlv2 =~ 1*t2_lv         # This defines the dlv score as measured perfectly by scores on t2

t0~~res_var*t0      # This estimates the residual variances
t1~~res_var*t1      # This estimates the residual variances
t2~~res_var*t2      # This estimates the residual variances

#Dynamics

dlv1~selfFB1*t0_lv      # This estimates the self-feedback parameter (equality constrained across timepoints)
dlv2~selfFB2*t1_lv      # This estimates the self-feedback parameter (equality constrained across timepoints)

iCOG=~1*t0_lv                         # This defines the COG intercept measurement model
sCOG=~1*dlv1+1*dlv2          # This defines the COG slope measurement model
iCOG~1                                    # This estimates the COG intercept intercept (mean)
iCOG~~iCOG                          # This estimates the COG intercept variance
sCOG~1                                  # This estimates the COG slope intercept
sCOG~~sCOG                       # This estimates the COG slope variance
iCOG~~sCOG                        # This estimates the iCOG sCOG covariance        

'

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: bivariate dual change score with multiple groups
parts: I don't know where I should specify the different estimates for the 3 different groups

You can specify a vector of 3 fixed values or 3 labels, instead of only 1.  If you provide 1, then it will be recycled for all groups, with a warning from lavaan to make you aware of that.  You can ignore the warning, as it might be exactly what you want in some cases (e.g., the slopes/loadings fixed to 1 in all groups).

https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/groups.html
